title: The Dual System (Diarchy) in Bengal
definition: A political and administrative arrangement introduced by Robert Clive in 1765, where the East India Company exercised 'Diwani' (revenue collection) rights while the Nawab of Bengal retained 'Nizamat' (police and judicial) responsibilities.
importanceInUpsc: It marks the transition of the EIC from a trading body to a territorial sovereign, serving as the root cause of the 1770 Bengal Famine and the subsequent Regulating Act of 1773.
learningOutcomes: Master foundational concepts and mechanisms of The Dual System.
Evaluate spatial distribution, institutional frameworks, and policy dimensions.
Apply high-yield mnemonics to solve tricky Prelims and Mains questions.
